## Green theme, rebuilt like Spotify
Switch it on under Settings → Look → Themes + → Green.

- **Same frame:** black window, #121212 panels with 8px gaps, a small panel for the pages and a big one for your playlists
- **Same type:** a round geometric font, white titles, everything quiet in grey (#b3b3b3), huge black titles on albums, playlists and artists
- **Title bar (Windows and Linux app):** round Home button and the big search field in the middle, back and forward on the left, Home and Search move out of the sidebar
- **Page heads:** large cover with a soft shadow, the actions in their own row: a big green play button, then plain icons, Follow as an outlined pill
- **Song rows:** 56px high, the row lights up under the mouse, title and artist turn white, the playing song is green
- **Saving songs like Spotify:** a thin plus in a circle, a green circle with a tick once a song is saved. Add to playlist is in the ... menu
- **Player bar:** 72px, white round play button, grey icons that turn white, shuffle and repeat green with a small dot when on, the seek and volume bars turn green under the mouse
- **Cards and shortcuts:** the green play button rises out of the cover, shortcuts on Home show a small play button on the right
- **Menus and dialogs:** #282828 with 4px corners, 40px items
- **Phone:** flat grey shortcut tiles, green chips when chosen, white search field, the mini player tinted from the cover with a thin progress line, the big player with a white 64px play button, the tab bar fading to black

The other themes look the same as before.

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
